title: Students per grade level
statementMd:
Count students in each grade level.

Expected columns: `grade_level`, `students`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT grade_level, COUNT(*) AS students FROM students GROUP BY grade_level;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
